---
name: Theme bug
about: Report a theme validation, installation or appearance problem
title: "fix(theme): "
---

Describe the problem and expected appearance. Include the theme ID, ARGVUS
version, selected layout, relevant manifest entries and the output of
`argvus theme check src/usr/share/argvus/themes/<id>`.

Provide reproduction steps and screenshots when relevant. Remove credentials
from any Git URL before sharing it.
